messages:
anya: Heads up — we're landing new reliability metrics for degraded mode, 5xx, timeouts, OOM. Need input on instrumentation & dashboard panels before next week's rollout.

mike: Do we have specific metric names? Datadog/Prom queries? We need counters & per-route rates.

anya: Proposed names: infra.request_errors.count, infra.request_timeouts.count, infra.ooms.count, infra.degraded_entries.count, infra.fallbacks.count. Also histograms for latency: infra.latency.p50 and infra.latency.p95.

samir: Prefer dot-separated metric names to match existing telemetry. Also prefer counters (monotonic) for errors, histograms for latency.

jess: Question: where should these be emitted? Runtime (C++), API gateway, or both? OOMs come from runtime, but timeouts and 5xx sometimes from the LB.

lia: Runtime can emit counters directly. Gateway should emit what it observes with tag source=gateway. We'll dedupe by preferring runtime as the canonical source when available.

mike: On dashboard: panels per-route with stacked bars for 5xx/timeouts/fallbacks and a 'degraded mode' timeline overlay.

anya: Fallback details we need: reason (quantize, capacity, policy), fallback_target. Cardinality controls are required — don't emit raw model names for low-traffic routes.

jess: Agreed. For telemetry ingestion, prefer emitting aggregated counters rather than high-cardinality events. If we need events for debugging, sample them.

samir: Suggested metric labels: route, model, model_variant (optional), region, tier, error_type, fallback_reason. Mark model_variant as optional to limit cardinality.

lia: Security check: ensure no prompt or PII gets attached to metrics. Confirmed — metrics should never include prompt text.

oncall-bot: Incident alert at 1845498000 — runtime OOM spike detected in us-west-2; auto-rollout to smaller batch size triggered.

mike: Add a counter that increments when auto-rollout triggers (degraded_mode_triggered{policy="autoscale"}). That will help correlate fallout.

anya: Action items: 1) finalize metric names (mike + samir), 2) runtime emits counters + tags (eng-runtime), 3) gateway emits with source tag (eng-platform), 4) draft onboarding doc + dashboards (product + observability), 5) sampling/scrubbing plan (eng-sre).

jess: Dashboard query examples:
- Datadog: sum:infra.request_errors.count{route:$route}.rollup(sum,60)
- Prom: sum by(route, error_type) (increase(infra_request_errors_total[5m]))

samir: Prom example for degraded entries: sum(infra_degraded_entries_total) by (route)

lia: Datadog note: emit counts as count metrics (not gauges) so rolls and alerting behave as expected.

anya: I'll open a PR with the canonical names and a draft JSON dashboard. Will ping owners when ready.

mike: For alerts/SLOs: propose on-call alert if error_rate >0.5% p95 over 5m for critical routes. Need to tune.

jess: API question: should fallback_count be visible to tenants in the console? I prefer internal-only, but an aggregated fallback_rate is fine.

samir: Internal-only metrics; expose aggregated fallback_rate to tenants with limited cardinality and delay.

lia: Agreed. Also add a retention note — keep high-cardinality tags for 14 days only, aggregated counts longer.

anya: Great — set up a short sync for Thursday to finalize names. Thanks all :thumbsup:
